name: dsfd_sp_pq_c-v1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 layer-die PQ core slot dsfd_sp_pq (contract v15 rep/pqc/dsfd_sp_pq, 1672.248 x 449.256) as ONE hardened cluster: wires only (0 flops; ties on unused relay bits) over the closed PQ spine tiles T_XIN x2, T_AQ x2, T_IX x4, T_QB, T_CTL16, T_RET x2 and 8 x T_BC (five relay flops on every broadcast bit), placed by tools/s81/sp_pq_plan.py from the routed child LEFs: every tile-to-tile / pin-to-tile hop <= 500 um (longest 467), every pin of the cluster straight in front of the child pin it wires to (io_tcl), clock spine balanced to the child insertions (TT 106..312 ps). Screen shape (PHW 6, SAW 8, KMAX 256, R 16): cycle-exact to the flat v14 screen with the ROM fixtures out (ROM ports on the N face). Replaces the generated placeholder of the slot.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_sp_pq u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/pq/dsfd_sp_pq.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_sp_pq_c/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_sp_pq_c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_sp_pq_c --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_sp_pq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_dsrom_aq12t_m5/views/ot_dsrom_aq12t --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_bc_m5/views/ot_pqc_t_bc --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_ctl16_m5/views/ot_pqc_t_ctl16 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_qb_m5/views/ot_pqc_t_qb --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_ret_m5/views/ot_pqc_t_ret --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_xin_m5/views/ot_pqc_t_xin --macro-view physical/ref_tile/pqc_ix_rt/views/ot_pqc_t_ix > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
